source_checks.finding: Section 'Pair a Bluetooth accessory through the Settings app' says: 'From the top of the screen, swipe down.', 'Touch and hold Bluetooth', 'Tap Pair new device.', 'check under Available devices' or 'tap More' then 'Refresh', 'To pair your device, tap the name of the Bluetooth device.', 'Follow the on-screen instructions.', 'automatically connect your Bluetooth devices with Fast Pair', and 'Some of these steps work only on Android 15 and up.' The page's Important note says 'Some of these steps only work on devices with supporting hardware,' which matches the ref's applicability. The page does not say the earbuds must be put into pairing mode, so no such step is required from this ref.

Distractor, correctly unused. The page is Microsoft's Windows guide and its Applies To line names Windows 11 (it also covers Windows 10). It says the Windows device needs Bluetooth, which a USB adapter can supply, and says 'Follow additional instructions if they appear, then select Done.' This does not apply to this Android user, so no step from it belongs in the answer.

required_actions.action: Swipe down from the top of the screen to open quick settings
If Pair new device is missing, check Available devices or tap More, then Refresh
Tap the name of the earbuds in the list
Note that a pairing notification uses Fast Pair to connect automatically
Note that some steps work only on Android 15 and up
